firmware.name: Snapshot PB autococker firmware
firmware.summary: The firmware of the Snapshot PB autococker board. This example covers the root screen, the Fire screen, the Ramping screen, and the Eye screen.

enter.name: ENTER
enter.description: The centre button. It selects a row, commits a value, and opens the menu.

short.description: A press and a release in less than the hold time.

long.description: A press that lasts the hold time or longer.

up.name: UP
up.description: The top button. It moves the cursor up and increases a value.

short.description: A press and a release in less than the hold time.

long.description: A press that lasts the hold time or longer.

down.name: DOWN
down.description: The bottom button. It moves the cursor down and decreases a value.

lockout.name: LOCKOUT
lockout.description: The lockout button. It locks and unlocks the settings.

open_menu.description: Opens the root menu from the home screen.

cursor_up.description: Moves the cursor one row up. On the first row, it stays.

cursor_down.description: Moves the cursor one row down. On the last row, it stays.

select.description: Opens the row under the cursor. A submenu row opens its screen. A setting row opens its editor. A toggle row changes its value at once.

back.description: On the Back row, returns to the parent screen. On the root screen, returns to the home screen.

value_up.description: In an editor, increases the value by one step, or moves to the next option. The value stops at the maximum.

value_down.description: In an editor, decreases the value by one step, or moves to the previous option. The value stops at the minimum.

commit.description: In an editor, stores the value and returns to the screen. An editor has no cancel.

power_off.description: Turns the board off from each screen that takes input.

eye_override.description: Turns the eyes off or on for this session. The stored eye mode does not change.

lockout_toggle.description: Locks or unlocks the settings. While locked, the board shows the shot counter only.

home.title: Shot counter
home.description: The screen that the board shows after the boot caption. It shows the shot count and the state marks. The menu opens from this screen.

indicators.bluetooth: The Bluetooth mark shows while the Bluetooth radio is on.
indicators.eyes: The eye mark shows the eye state: on, off, or overridden for this session.

root.title: Menu
root.description: The first screen of the menu. The two rows at the top select how the whole board looks. The submenu rows below them hold the settings of one subject each.

device_config.active_profile.title: Profile
device_config.active_profile.description: The profile that the board uses. The board holds four profiles. Each profile holds its own fire, timing, trigger, and eye settings.

runtime.bluetooth_active.title: Bluetooth
runtime.bluetooth_active.description: Turns the Bluetooth radio on or off. The board starts with the radio off at each boot. The application connects only while the radio is on.

autococker.fire_mode.title: Fire mode
autococker.fire_mode.description: How the board answers a trigger pull.

options.description: The board does not fire the solenoids. The marker fires by its mechanical linkage only.
One shot for each trigger pull.
Ramping under the NXL 2026 rules. The Ramping screen holds its settings.

profile.fire_rate_cap.title: BPS cap
profile.fire_rate_cap.description: The maximum rate of fire, in balls per second. The board does not fire faster than this value in any fire mode.

autococker.ramping_custom_multiplier.title: Ramping multiplier
autococker.ramping_custom_multiplier.description: The number of shots that the board adds for each trigger pull while ramping is active.

autococker.eye_mode.title: Eye mode
autococker.eye_mode.description: The type of eye sensor in the breech. The board uses the eye to wait for a ball before it fires.

options.description: The board does not read the eye.
One sensor reads the light that a ball reflects.
A ball breaks a beam between an emitter and a detector.

autococker.eye_threshold.title: Eye threshold
autococker.eye_threshold.description: The level, in percent, above which the eye reports a ball.

ramping_off.description: The fire mode is not a ramping mode.

no_eye_phase.description: The fire mode has no phase that waits for the eye.

eye_inactive.description: The fire mode has no eye phase, or the eye mode is OFF.

topic.power_off.title: Turn the board off
topic.power_off.description: Hold ENTER for the hold time. The board turns off. Press a button to turn the board on.

topic.lockout.title: Lockout
topic.lockout.description: Press LOCKOUT to lock the settings. The board shows the shot counter and ignores UP, DOWN, and ENTER. Press LOCKOUT again to unlock.

topic.eye_override.title: Eye override
topic.eye_override.description: Hold UP on the home screen to turn the eyes off for this session, for example after an eye fails in a game. Hold UP again to turn them on. The stored eye mode does not change, and the next boot uses the stored eye mode.
